title: A Train Floated Above Its Track at 375 Miles an Hour

scenes.text: A train in Japan floated at three hundred seventy-five miles an hour.
In April 2015, a maglev hit six hundred three kilometres an hour.
It's the fastest train ever built, on a test line in Yamanashi.
Magnets lift it off the track, so there's almost no friction at speed.
A normal bullet train tops out near two hundred miles an hour.
This one floats at nearly double that.

description:
In April 2015 a Japanese maglev train reached 603 kilometres an hour, about 375 miles an hour.
It is the fastest train ever recorded.
Would you ride it?
first_comment: Would you ride a train at 375 mph? Yes or no?
